fields.name: pageload

fields.name: navigation
fields.description: Client-side browser history change in a web application.

fields.description: A client-side automatic redirect navigation (e.g. from framework router redirects) triggerign a browser history change.

fields.name: resource
fields.description: Resource as per [Performance Resource Timing](https://w3c.github.io/resource-timing/#sec-performanceresourcetiming). Defaults to resource.other if resource cannot be indentified.

fields.name: resource.worker
fields.description: Loading of a resource initiated by a worker (e.g. Web Worker or Service Worker).

fields.name: resource.icon
fields.description: Loading of an icon resource.

fields.name: resource.frame
fields.description: Loading of a resource initiated by a frame.

fields.name: resource.object
fields.description: Loading of a resource initiated by an `<object>` element.

fields.description: A hyperlink auditing ping request.

fields.name: resource.track
fields.description: Loading of a `<track>` element resource (e.g. subtitles or captions).

fields.name: browser
fields.description: Usage of browser APIs or functionality

fields.description: The unload event phase of a browser navigation.

fields.name: browser.redirect
fields.description: The redirect phase of a browser navigation.

fields.name: browser.dom_content_loaded_event
fields.description: The DOMContentLoaded event phase of a browser navigation.

fields.description: The load event phase of a browser navigation.

fields.description: The connection phase of a browser navigation.

fields.name: ui
fields.description: Operations related to browser UI

fields.name: ui.task
fields.description: A task that is taken on the main UI thread. Typically used to indicate to users about things like the [Long Tasks API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PerformanceLongTaskTiming).

fields.name: ui.mount
fields.description: Mounting of a UI component or application (e.g. initial render/bootstrap).

fields.name: ui.update
fields.description: Updating of an already-mounted UI component.

fields.name: ui.unmount
fields.description: Unmounting/teardown of a UI component.

fields.name: ui.long_task
fields.description: A long task on the main UI thread, as reported by the Long Tasks API.

fields.name: ui.long_animation_frame
fields.description: A long animation frame, as reported by the Long Animation Frames API.

fields.name: ui.interaction.click
fields.description: A click interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP).

fields.name: ui.interaction.hover
fields.description: A hover interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP).

fields.name: ui.interaction.drag
fields.description: A drag interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP).

fields.name: ui.interaction.press
fields.description: A key press interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP).
